comparison.objective: Candidate extracts one terminal from a connector housing; record releases and removes a graphics card from a slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate bends a wire, inserts a thin blade under a recessed tab, maintains tool-wire contact, and co-withdraws them; record depresses an accessible latch with one hand and lifts a large card straight up with the other.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires the intended terminal out with no crimp separation, housing damage, or neighboring release; record requires latch-first card extraction and stable placement in a tray, with a broken-latch gate.
comparison.reason: This is the closest release-before-pull record, but miniature under-tab probing plus same-direction tool-wire withdrawal is a meaningfully different tested ability from button pressing and orthogonal card lifting.
